Paramount Nears Settlement in Warner Bros. Merger Lawsuit

Paramount Global is reportedly in advanced settlement talks with several U.S. states over its proposed merger with Warner Bros. Discovery. Sources suggest a settlement could be reached as soon as this weekend. Paramount has discussed potential concessions, including measures to safeguard the editorial independence of CNN and the divestiture of Comedy Central. These discussions are aimed at resolving a lawsuit filed by 12 states, with California's Attorney General reportedly involved in the accelerated negotiations.
